unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting with triage-nurse-annotated exemplar messages to route patient portal messages, compared with zero-shot prompting
Continuous improvement of the routing model by annotating new exemplar messages for edge cases

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM chain-of-thought framework for classifying and routing patient portal messages against nurse gold-standard annotations (offline retrospective/benchmark evaluation). It compares CoT prompting to zero-shot as a prompt engineering/model technique rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
